# Alert
Inline message that explains status or feedback in place. Not a toast.

**When to use** — form-level errors, an explanation above a step, a persistent notice in page flow.
**When not to** — transient confirmations (no Toast exists — log a candidate), or a blocking decision (Dialog).

## Variants
`info` `success` `warning` `danger`. Figma also defines `neutral` and size `lg`; the code has neither yet (see `state/discrepancies.json`).

## Do
- Give at least a `title` or a `description`.
- Put recovery actions in the actions slot, as Buttons.
- Use `danger` only for something that failed or will fail.

## Don't
- Don't render an Alert for every field error — attach those to the field.
- Don't make an Alert dismissible when the condition it describes is still true.

```tsx
<Alert variant="warning" title="Rate expires in 2 minutes" description="Confirm to lock it in." />
```
